# The Railway: Sensible, Slow, and Tapira's

President Vento has chosen the National Railway Integration as her first great project — a choice the Ledger can find little fault with, which is itself a kind of criticism. Grain will reach Katanaí more cheaply; Mognagna will be connected to something; Tekoku will be connected to Ibicuí. Nobody will see the full benefit before the next election. Governor Arturo Trembolo has already asked where the stations will go.
